cases.description: Fresh live Hypothesis Maker output that should preserve candidate/provisional dependence.

expectations.note: The reported electronic-structure premise is preserved, while the provisional relation is not rewritten as an established result.
The unresolved causal-control question remains motivational/gap content rather than a positive premise.

The provisional status is explicitly preserved. Pass is appropriate when candidate propagation itself is the focus; warning is also acceptable when the relatively strong functional role assigned to the provisional relation is treated conservatively.

The bridge is a bounded and explicitly hypothetical mechanistic extension, but it also introduces a more specific mediator/dependence claim than the supplied association. Both pass and warning are defensible under the rubric.
Causal language is clearly framed as hypothetical/proposed, not as a reported causal finding.
The prediction remains qualitative and does not introduce an unsupported monotonic direction or magnitude.
The predicted catalytic response follows directly from the proposed electronic-state mediation/dependence.

The falsifier provides meaningful counterevidence to the proposed transition-response relationship, while also testing a stronger coupling interpretation than every reading of the weaker 'may contribute' claim. Both pass and warning are defensible.
This is a single-source controlled case and contains no cross-paper conflation.
Only one hypothesis is present, so portfolio-level distinctness is not applicable.
There is sufficient eligible evidence, including an explicitly provisional premise, to justify a bounded non-abstaining hypothesis.

cases.note: E2 controlled-context live Hypothesis Maker output; not additional corpus evidence. Human review focus: candidate_calibration should recognize the provisional premise; causal wording must remain hypothetical.
